statusDetail: Atomic coverage complete across 58 checks and two representative paths. This is a genuinely single-page informational disclaimer; linked legal documents are on surveza.ai and were excluded as a different host, while the same-host 404 failure surface was included.

page.notes: Public Surveza survey-infrastructure disclaimer. Coverage includes the only same-host content page and an unknown-URL failure state. External Terms, Privacy, and Cookies pages on surveza.ai, individual unknown survey landing URLs, authenticated flows, and user-generated survey templates were not covered because they are outside this hostname or not discoverable from sitemap/navigation.

paths.description: The sole public same-host content archetype: Surveza infrastructure disclaimer, tested at desktop/mobile and preference conditions.
Same-host HTTP failure/recovery surface for an unknown URL.

findings.summary: The page has no user-preference-driven dark theme.
findings.evidence: The dark-condition screenshot is pixel-identical to the default screenshot; the computed probe reports color-scheme: normal and no prefers-color-scheme, color-scheme, or light-dark() CSS.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme: light dark and retint the page surfaces and text with prefers-color-scheme or light-dark(), preserving contrast in both schemes.

findings.summary: Keyboard focus is intentionally removed from every link.
findings.evidence: The rendered CSS contains :focus { outline: 0 }, input:focus { outline: none }, and a:hover/a:active { outline: none }; the focus probe reports outlineStyle none for all nine links.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove the global focus reset and add a high-contrast :focus-visible indicator with sufficient offset, while retaining native focus as fallback.

findings.summary: Small body copy fails WCAG AA contrast.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reports #7d7d7d 12px text on #fff at 4.11:1, below the 4.5:1 minimum, across the explanatory copy and copyright.
findings.suggestedFix: Darken the secondary text color to achieve at least 4.5:1, and verify all link states and both preference themes.

findings.summary: The document has no heading structure and no visible focus state.
findings.evidence: The DOM probe finds zero h1-h6 elements despite multiple visually styled titles, and the focus walk finds outlineStyle none on every link.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a descriptive h1 and nested h2 headings for the page sections, then restore a visible :focus-visible treatment and verify tab order.

findings.summary: The only visible brand text is hidden from assistive technology, and an injected tracking image lacks alt.
findings.evidence: The logo image renders the Surveza name but has alt="" with no adjacent brand text; Lighthouse also flags the injected rtmark tracking img for having no alt attribute.
findings.suggestedFix: Give the brand image concise alt text such as “Surveza”; mark purely decorative/tracking images alt="" at creation time.

findings.summary: Search metadata does not describe this domain disclaimer.
findings.evidence: The title is only “Surveza” and there is no meta description; Lighthouse SEO scores 0.82 and fails meta-description.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a descriptive title such as “Surveza survey infrastructure domain” and add a concise meta description matching the visible disclaimer.

findings.summary: The public page provides no canonical, robots.txt, or sitemap indexing signals.
findings.evidence: The DOM probe finds no canonical or robots meta, while /robots.txt and /sitemap.xml both return the generic nginx 404 response.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a self-referencing canonical, a valid robots.txt, and a minimal sitemap containing the public disclaimer URL.

findings.summary: Browser-enforced security headers are largely absent, and HSTS is effectively disabled.
findings.evidence: The headers primitive finds no CSP, clickjacking policy, Referrer-Policy, or Permissions-Policy; HSTS is max-age=1 second. HTTPS and nosniff are present.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy a restrictive CSP including frame-ancestors, set durable HSTS after validating subdomains, and add Referrer-Policy plus a least-privilege Permissions-Policy.

findings.summary: Full-session analytics and cookie syncing start before any consent or user action.
findings.evidence: The DOM initializes Yandex Metrika with webvisor:true, clickmap:true, and trackLinks:true on load. HAR records 15/21 third-party requests and 125,641/156,183 transferred bytes; cookie and Lighthouse evidence shows first-party SameSite=None analytics cookies plus 16 third-party cookies, while no consent UI appears.
findings.suggestedFix: Do not start Webvisor/cookie-sync tracking before informed consent. Prefer privacy-preserving aggregate analytics, collect only necessary events, batch them, and document retention and recipients.

findings.summary: Throttled mobile LCP is outside the good Core Web Vitals range.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measures LCP 3.5s and FCP 2.6s (performance 0.87), while the unthrottled trace is fast at 794ms with 0ms blocking, indicating network dependencies rather than main-thread work.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritize the first-view content, self-host or remove the render-blocking font, and defer non-essential analytics so LCP stays at or below 2.5s under mobile throttling.

findings.summary: The logo has no intrinsic dimensions and contributes to measurable layout shift.
findings.evidence: Both the images primitive and Lighthouse flag the logo as missing width/height; layout records CLS 0.021 desktop and 0.041 mobile.
findings.suggestedFix: Set the SVG logo width and height attributes (or a stable aspect-ratio) so its space is reserved before it loads.

findings.summary: A large analytics bundle dominates this otherwise tiny static page and is mostly unused.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimates 47 KiB of unused JavaScript in the 89 KiB Yandex Metrika bundle (53.9% unused); HAR shows it is the largest resource and third parties account for 80% of transferred bytes.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove full-session analytics or load a minimal analytics path only after consent and when needed; avoid shipping the Webvisor feature set on this static disclaimer.

findings.summary: Unknown URLs dead-end at an unbranded nginx error with no recovery action.
findings.evidence: The tested missing URL correctly returns HTTP 404 but shows only “404 Not Found / nginx”, with no explanation, home link, support link, or route back to the disclaimer.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve a branded 404 that preserves the status code, explains what happened, and offers links to the homepage and support.

findings.summary: The public informational page has no social-preview or structured entity metadata.
findings.evidence: The metadata probe finds no Open Graph fields and no JSON-LD despite the page representing the Surveza organization and its support contact.
findings.suggestedFix: Add accurate Open Graph title/description/image fields and a small schema.org Organization JSON-LD block matching visible content.
